text: The system shall allow users to reset their password via a link sent to their registered email address.
Users shall be able to reset a forgotten password using a reset link emailed to their registered address.
The system shall log every failed login attempt with a timestamp and source IP address.
Each unsuccessful login attempt shall be recorded together with its time and originating IP address.
The application shall support English and French user interfaces.
The user interface shall be available in both English and French.
The system shall generate a PDF invoice for each completed order.
A PDF invoice shall be produced by the system whenever an order is completed.
The system shall send an SMS notification when a parcel is out for delivery.
Customers shall receive a text message once their parcel has left for delivery.
Only administrators shall be able to create new user accounts.
The creation of new user accounts shall be restricted to administrators.
The system shall back up the database every night at 02:00.
A nightly database backup shall run at 2 a.m.
The search page shall allow filtering products by price range.
Users shall be able to filter products on the search page by a minimum and maximum price.
The system shall display the remaining account balance on the dashboard.
The dashboard shall show the user's current account balance.
The system shall automatically log out a user after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Users who are inactive for 15 minutes shall be signed out automatically.
The system shall export the monthly sales report in CSV format.
The monthly sales report shall be exportable as a CSV file.
All personal data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256.
The system shall store personal data encrypted with AES-256.
The mobile app shall work on Android 12 and later.
The mobile application shall support Android version 12 or newer.
The system shall allow a customer to cancel an order before it ships.
Customers shall be able to cancel their order as long as it has not yet been shipped.
The system shall send a reminder email 24 hours before a scheduled appointment.
An email reminder shall be sent one day ahead of every scheduled appointment.
The system shall allow the librarian to register a new book with its ISBN title and author.
The librarian shall be able to add a new book by entering its ISBN title and author.
The system shall allow members to renew a borrowed book up to two times.
A member may renew a borrowed book at most twice.
The system shall calculate shipping costs based on parcel weight and destination.
Shipping fees shall be computed from the weight of the parcel and the delivery destination.
The system shall require two-factor authentication for all administrator logins.
Administrators shall log in using two-factor authentication.
The system shall display product reviews sorted by most recent first.
Product reviews shall be listed with the newest review at the top.
The system shall allow patients to book an appointment online.
Patients shall be able to schedule appointments through the website.
The system shall show the estimated delivery date at checkout.
During checkout the expected delivery date shall be displayed to the customer.
The system shall prevent the same email address from being used for two accounts.
Each email address shall be linked to at most one user account.
The system shall keep a history of all changes made to a customer record.
Every modification of a customer record shall be stored in a change history.
The system shall allow teachers to upload course material as PDF files.
Teachers shall be able to publish course documents in PDF format.
The system shall notify the warehouse when stock of an item falls below 10 units.
A notification shall be sent to the warehouse whenever an item's stock drops under 10 units.
The system shall let users change their profile picture.
Users shall be able to update the photo shown on their profile.
The system shall reject passwords shorter than 12 characters.
Passwords with fewer than 12 characters shall not be accepted.
The system shall allow drivers to mark a delivery as completed in the mobile app.
In the mobile app a driver shall be able to confirm that a delivery is done.
The system shall print a receipt after each cash payment.
A receipt shall be printed whenever a customer pays in cash.
The system shall archive closed support tickets after 90 days.
Support tickets that have been closed for 90 days shall be moved to the archive.
The system shall allow managers to approve or reject leave requests.
Leave requests shall be approved or declined by a manager.
The system shall display prices including VAT.
All prices shown to customers shall include value added tax.
The system shall reset the password via an SMS code.
The system shall log every successful login with a timestamp.
The application shall support German and Spanish user interfaces.
The system shall generate a PDF receipt for each refund.
The system shall send an SMS notification when a payment fails.
Only administrators shall be able to delete user accounts.
The system shall back up uploaded documents every hour.
The search page shall allow sorting products by popularity.
The dashboard shall show the number of open support tickets.
The system shall automatically lock the screen after 5 minutes of inactivity.
The system shall export the annual tax report in XLSX format.
All personal data shall be transmitted over TLS 1.3.
The mobile app shall work on iOS 16 and later.
The system shall allow a customer to return an order within 30 days of delivery.
The system shall send a reminder email 7 days before a library loan expires.
The system shall allow the librarian to remove a damaged book from the catalogue.
The system shall calculate import duties based on the declared value of the parcel.
The system shall require a password change every 90 days for administrators.
The system shall display product reviews with a star rating from 1 to 5.
The system shall allow patients to cancel an appointment online.
The system shall show the shipping cost at checkout.
The system shall allow two accounts to share the same phone number.
The system shall keep a history of all payments made by a customer.
The system shall allow students to upload assignments as PDF files.
The system shall notify the purchasing team when an item is out of stock.
The system shall let users change their display name.
The system shall reject usernames longer than 30 characters.
The system shall allow drivers to report a damaged parcel in the mobile app.
The system shall email a receipt after each card payment.
The system shall delete spam messages after 30 days.
The system shall allow employees to submit leave requests.
The system shall display prices in the customer's local currency.
The system shall provide an audit trail of all configuration changes.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users.
